## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/02.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Student Growth Percentiles Provide:
■ Useful measures of student growth
 ■ Typical Growth
 ■ Adequate Growth

■ Identification of programs associated with
 unusually high or low levels of growth
■ Individualized projections of what future levels
 of growth will “buy” a student in terms of
 performance levels

June 17, 2008 2</div>
```

## {.archive-slide background-image="slides/15.webp" background-size="contain" background-color="#14140f"}

```{=html}
<div class="archive-text">Several Benefits of Student Growth
Percentiles:
■ Understandable at conceptual level which is
 critical for generating meaningful discussions
■ Provides defensible and actionable answers to
 basic questions about academic growth
■ Not overly dependent on measurement
 properties of underlying instrument
■ Readily supports secondary analysis at district
 and school level

June 17, 2008 15</div>
```
